name: Richard Descartes
source: A quiet artist that sometimes comes off as a bit creepy and unsettling. Despite this, he tends to be mild-mannered, polite, and kind but is also prone to bouts of extreme passion when the time calls for it. Often he’s found observing other people from afar, looking them right in the eye… as if searching for something. What could the man be doing in such a dangerous game with his father?
